nodes.description: Privileged address allowed to manage the vault and open/close shorts.
Option the vault will short in the next cycle.
Timestamp after which nextOption may be rolled into.
Option currently shorted by the vault.
Amount locked in the options protocol as collateral for the short.
Cap on total deposits accepted into the vault.
Fee (in 1e18 units) charged on instant withdrawals.
Recipient of withdrawal fees.
Immutable collateral/premium asset used by the vault.
Immutable underlying asset of the options.
Immutable Wrapped Ether token address.
Immutable USDC token address used as strike asset.
Immutable options protocol adapter used for delegatecalls.
Immutable Airswap swap contract used to sell option tokens.
Immutable flag indicating whether the vault shorts puts.
Immutable ratio of balance locked into the short (0.9 ether).
Immutable delay between setting next option and rolling to it.
Immutable minimum asset and share supply to prevent inflation attacks.
Sets immutable configuration of the vault including asset, adapter and swap contract.
One-time initializer configuring owner, fee recipient, cap, name and symbol.
Owner-only function to change the vault manager.
Owner-only function to change the withdrawal fee recipient.
Manager-only function to set the instant withdrawal fee.
Payable deposit of ETH that wraps into WETH then mints vault shares.
Pulls asset tokens from the caller and mints vault shares.
Internal share calculation and minting logic for deposits.
Burns shares and sends ETH back to msg.sender via a low-level call.
Burns shares and transfers the asset back to msg.sender.
Internal withdrawal logic: computes amounts, burns shares, pays fee.
Manager-only function that sets the next option and closes the current short.
Public function to close the current short position.
Validates option terms and stores nextOption with a ready-at timestamp.
Closes the current short after expiry and resets locked state.
Manager-only function that rolls vault funds into a new short via the adapter.
Manager-only emergency close of the current short.
Manager-only function that executes an Airswap order to sell option tokens.
Manager-only function to update the vault deposit cap.
View returning the expiry timestamp of the currently shorted option.
View computing withdrawable asset amount and fee for a given share amount.
Internal helper computing withdraw amount, new balance and new share supply.
View returning the maximum withdrawable shares for the vault.
View returning the max amount an account can withdraw.
View converting an asset amount to a share amount.
View returning an account's withdrawable vault balance.
View returning locked amount plus freely available asset balance.
View returning the vault's free asset balance.
View returning the share token decimals.
Modifier restricting execution to the vault manager.
Attacker-controlled caller used in deposit, withdraw, manager check and ETH transfer.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for option readiness and expiry checks.
Low-level call{value:} sending ETH to msg.sender in withdrawETH.
delegatecall into the options adapter executing external code in vault context.
External call to the Airswap SWAP_CONTRACT.swap.
Share/withdraw arithmetic (mul/div) whose rounding and overflow are security-sensitive.
New manager address passed to setManager.
New fee recipient address passed to setFeeRecipient.
New withdrawal fee passed to setWithdrawalFee.
Amount of asset deposited in deposit.
Share amount burned in withdraw.
Share amount burned in withdrawETH.
Option terms passed to commitAndClose.
New deposit cap passed to setCap.
Airswap order passed to sellOptions.
Local amount computed in withdrawETH before sending ETH.
Local success flag of the low-level ETH call in withdrawETH.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the account whose asset tokens are pulled in deposit.
msg.sender is the recipient of the ETH sent by withdrawETH.
msg.sender receives the withdrawn asset tokens in withdraw.
msg.sender is the call target of the low-level ETH transfer.
onlyManager compares msg.sender with the stored manager.
block.timestamp is used to compute nextOptionReadyAt.
block.timestamp is compared against the option expiry in _closeShort.
block.timestamp gates rollToNextOption via nextOptionReadyAt.
manager state variable is read by the onlyManager modifier.
cap is enforced as an upper bound in _deposit.
instantWithdrawalFee is used to compute the withdrawal fee.
feeRecipient receives the withdrawal fee in _withdraw.
lockedAmount is part of totalBalance.
MINIMUM_SUPPLY is enforced in _deposit.
MINIMUM_SUPPLY bounds share and asset supply in withdrawAmountWithShares.
SWAP_CONTRACT is invoked in sellOptions.
adapter is used to create the short in rollToNextOption.
adapter address is the delegatecall target.
lockedRatio determines the short amount in rollToNextOption.
currentOption is read and reset in emergencyWithdrawFromShort.
nextOption is consumed when rolling into a new short.
delay is added to block.timestamp to compute nextOptionReadyAt.
nextOptionReadyAt gates rollToNextOption.
withdrawETH triggers the low-level ETH call.
rollToNextOption performs a delegatecall into the adapter.
emergencyWithdrawFromShort performs a delegatecall into the adapter.
sellOptions performs an external call to the swap contract.
_deposit computes share amounts with mul/div arithmetic.
_withdrawAmountWithShares computes withdraw amounts with mul/div arithmetic.
withdrawAmountWithShares delegates to _withdrawAmountWithShares.
commitAndClose calls the manager-controlled _setNextOption.
commitAndClose closes the existing short.
closeShort delegates to _closeShort.
depositETH wraps ETH and calls the internal deposit logic.
deposit calls the internal deposit logic after transferring tokens.
withdrawETH calls _withdraw to burn shares and compute the amount.
withdraw calls _withdraw to burn shares and compute the amount.
_withdraw uses withdrawAmountWithShares to compute amounts.
maxWithdrawableShares uses the share math helper.
maxWithdrawAmount uses maxWithdrawableShares.
accountVaultBalance uses _withdrawAmountWithShares.
onlyManager guards setWithdrawalFee.
onlyManager guards commitAndClose.
onlyManager guards rollToNextOption.
onlyManager guards emergencyWithdrawFromShort.
onlyManager guards sellOptions.
onlyManager guards setCap.
The low-level ETH call can re-enter withdrawETH before completion.
The swap contract call can re-enter the vault during sellOptions.
The delegatecall executes adapter code that can re-enter the vault.
newManager parameter flows into setManager.
newFeeRecipient parameter flows into setFeeRecipient.
newWithdrawalFee parameter flows into setWithdrawalFee.
amount parameter flows into deposit.
share parameter flows into withdraw.
share parameter flows into withdrawETH.
optionTerms parameter drives the manager-controlled short setup.
newCap parameter flows into setCap.
order parameter flows into the manager-controlled sellOptions.
withdrawAmount local is computed inside withdrawETH.
success local captures the low-level call result in withdrawETH.
